an9.10:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] nava ime bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an9.10:1.3: arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmiphala sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmi, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, gotrabhū.
an9.10:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, navapuggalā āhuneyyā …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
